correctness.rationale: For a path, distance >=3 between selected vertices is exactly the packing requirement. Edgeless uncovered induced complement forces every internal gap <=4, so successive gap lengths are 3 or 4; leading/trailing unselected slack is 0,1,2. Hence p_n(z) has generating series x+zx(1+x+x^2)^2/(1-z(x^3+x^4)), including empty S on P_1. For cycles, consecutive cyclic gaps are 3 or 4, including the singleton cases C3,C4; marked cyclic compositions give c_n(z) series z(3x^3+4x^4)/(1-z(x^3+x^4)). Allowed k intervals are ceil((n-1)/4)..floor((n+2)/3) for P_n and ceil(n/4)..floor(n/3) for C_n, with C5 the only empty interval among cycles n>=3. Graphs of maximum degree <=2 are disjoint unions, so polynomial multiplicativity and interval sums prove the full theorem. Independent direct subset tests against the defining edge and closed-neighborhood conditions covered P1..P12, C3..C12, all coefficients matched; finite checks corroborate not replace the bijections.
